title: Binary format for coded nondeterministic machines
statement: A code format for two-tape nondeterministic machines uses, for each state count, a pair of transition tables, one for each choice bit. It serializes a machine by pairing the binary expansion of its state parameter with the unary initial-state index followed by the two table encodings; its table reader recovers a table and the remaining bits, and its erasing reader discards the table encoding. The format has guard constant $702$ and uses a fixed fallback machine for malformed strings.
